name: transaction_velocity
description: Fraud read tool (tenant-scoped). Returns IP addresses with order-velocity bursts for the caller's tenant: IPs placing at least min_orders orders within the last window_hours, with per-IP order count, distinct customers, and value totals. Typed and enumerated — bounded parameters only, no caller-supplied SQL. tenant_id is the requested data scope (the Gateway governance layer authorizes whether the caller may select it).

tenant_id.description: Tenant whose data this operation is scoped to (requested data scope). The Gateway governance layer authorizes whether the caller may select it.

window_hours.description: Look-back window in hours, intended range 1..168 (default 24; upper bound capped server-side).

min_orders.description: Minimum orders from one IP within the window to be reported, intended floor 2 (default 3; enforced server-side).
